KPop Demon Hunters Launches New Merchandise and Enters Next Phase

The KPop Demon Hunters franchise announced the start of its next phase, introducing new merchandise, according to Outlook India. The Sydney Morning Herald reported that a forthcoming film is being discussed as potentially becoming the next installment in the KPop Demon Hunters series. Neither outlet provided specific release dates or product details. Both reports identified the franchise as expanding its media presence. No statements from the creators or companies involved were included.
